snp3.11:1.1: NIṬṬHITAṂ. Nālakasutta. Ānandajāte tidasagaṇe patīte sakkacca Indaṃ sucivasane ca deve dussaṃ gahetvā atiriva thomayante Asito isi addasa divāvihāre. || ||
snp3.11:2.1: Disvāna deve muditamane udagge cittiṃkaritvā idam avocāsi tattha: "kiṃ devasaṃgho atiriva kalyarīpo, dussaṃ gahetvā bhamayatha kiṃ paṭicca. || ||
snp3.11:3.1: Yadā pi āsi asurehi saṅgamo, jayo surānaṃ asurā parājitā, tadā pi n' etādiso lomahaṃsano: kim abbhutaṃ daṭṭhu marū pamoditā. || ||
snp3.11:4.1: Seḷenti gāyanti ca vādayanti ca bhujāni poṭhenti ca naccayanti ca, -- pucchāmi vo 'haṃ Merumuddhavāsine, dhunātha me saṃsayaṃ khippa mārisā". || ||
snp3.11:5.1: "So Bodhisatto ratanavaro atulyo manussaloke hitasukhatāya jāto Sakyānaṃ gāme janapade Lumbineyye, ten' amha tuṭṭhā atiriva kalyarūpā. || ||
snp3.11:6.1: So sabbasattutamo aggapuggalo narāsabho sabbapajānaṃ uttamo| vattessati cakkaṃ Isivhaye vane nadaṃ va sīho balavā migādhibhū". || ||
snp3.11:7.1: Taṃ saddaṃ sutvā turitam avaṃsarī so, Suddhodanassa tada bhavanaṃ upāgami, nisajja tattha idam avocāsi Sakye: "kuhiṃ kumāro, aham api daṭṭhukāmo". || ||
snp3.11:8.1: Tato kumāraṃ jalitam iva suvaṇṇaṃ ukkāmukhe va sukusalasampahaṭṭhaṃ daddallamānaṃ suriyā anomavaṇṇaṃ dassesu puttaṃ Asitavhayassa Sakyā. || ||
snp3.11:9.1: Disvā kumāraṃ sikhim iva pajjalantaṃ tārāsabhaṃ va nabhasigamaṃ visuddhaṃ suriyan tapantaṃ sarada-r-iv' abbhamuttaṃ ānandajāto vipulam alattha pītiṃ. || ||
snp3.11:10.1: Anekasākhañ ca sahassamaṇḍalaṃ chattaṃ marū dhārayum antalikkhe, sucaṇṇadaṇḍā vītipatanti cāmarā, na dissare cāmarachattagāhakā. || ||
snp3.11:11.1: Disvā jaṭi Kaṇhasirivhayo isi suvaṇṇanekkhaṃ viya paṇḍukambale setañ ca chattaṃ dhariyanta muddhani udaggacitto sumano paṭiggahe. || ||
snp3.11:12.1: Paṭiggahetvā pana Sakyapuṅgavaṃ jigiṃsako lakkhaṇamantapāragū pasannacitto giram abbhudīrayi: "anuttar' āyaṃ dipadānam uttamo". || ||
snp3.11:13.1: Ath' attano gamanam anussaranto akalyarūpo galayati assukāni, disvāna Sakyā isim avocuṃ rudantaṃ: "no ce kumāre bhavissati antarāyo". || ||
snp3.11:14.1: Disvāna Sakye isi-m-avoca akalye: "nāhaṃ kumāre ahitam anussarāmi, na cāpi-m-assa bhavissati antarāyo, na orak' āyaṃ, adhimanasā bhavātha. || ||
snp3.11:15.1: Sambodhiyaggaṃ phusissat' āyaṃ kumāro, so dhammacakkaṃ paramavisuddhadassī vattessat' āyaṃ bahujanahitānukampī, vitthārik' assa bhavissati brahmacariyaṃ. || ||
snp3.11:16.1: Mamañ ca āyu na ciram idhāvaseso, ath' antarā me bhavissati kālakiriyā, so 'haṃ na sussaṃ asamadhurassa dhammaṃ, ten' amhi aṭṭo vyasanagato aghāvī". || ||
snp3.11:17.1: So Sākiyānaṃ vipulaṃ janetva pūtiṃ antepuramhā niragama brahmacārī. -- So bhāgineyyaṃ sayam anukampamāno samādapesi asamadhurassa dhamme: || ||
snp3.11:18.1: "‘Buddho' ti ghosaṃ yada parato suṇāsi ‘sambodhipatto vicarati dhammamaggaṃ,' gantvāna tattha samayaṃ paripucchiyāno carassu tasmiṃ Bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ". || ||
snp3.11:19.1: Tenānusiṭṭho hitamanasena tādinā anāgate paramavisuddhadassinā so Nālako upacitapuññasañcayo Jinaṃ patikkhaṃ parivasi rakkhitindriyo. || ||
snp3.11:20.1: Sutvāna ghosaṃ Jinavaracakkavattane gantvāna disvā isinisabhaṃ pasanno| moneyyaseṭṭhaṃ munipavaraṃ apucchi samāgate Asitavhayassa sāsane ti || || Vatthugāthā niṭṭhitā.
snp3.11:21.1: "Aññātam etaṃ vacanaṃ Asitassa yathātathaṃ, taṃ taṃ Gotama pucchāma sabbadhammāna pāraguṃ: || ||
snp3.11:22.1: Anagāriy' upetassa bhikkhācariyaṃ jigiṃsato muni pabrūhi me puṭṭho moneyyaṃ uttamaṃ padaṃ". || ||
snp3.11:23.1: "Moneyyan te upaññissan ti Bhagavā dukkaraṃ durabhisambhavaṃ, handa te naṃ pavakkhāmi, santhambhassu daḷho bhava. || ||
snp3.11:24.1: Samānabhāvaṃ kubbetha gāme akkuṭṭhavanditaṃ, manopadosaṃ {rakkheyya}, santo anuṇṇato care. || ||
snp3.11:25.1: Uccāvacā niccharanti dāye aggisikhūpamā nariyo muniṃ palobhenti, tā su taṃ mā palobhayuṃ. || ||
snp3.11:26.1: Virato methunā dhammā hitvā kāme parovare aviruddho asāratto pāṇesu tasathāvare, || ||
snp3.11:27.1: ‘yathā ahaṃ tathā ete, yathā ete tathā ahaṃ,' attānaṃ upamaṃ katvā na haneyya na ghātaye. || ||
snp3.11:28.1: Hitvā icchañ ca lobhañ ca, yattha satto puthujjano, cakkhumā {paṭipajjeyya}, tareyya narakaṃ imaṃ. || ||
snp3.11:29.1: Ūnūdaro mitāhāro appicch' assa alolupo, sa ve icchāya nicchāto aniccho hoti nibbuto. || ||
snp3.11:30.1: Sa piṇḍacāraṃ caritvā vanantam abhihāraye upaṭṭhito rukkhamūlasmiṃ āsanūpagato muni. || ||
snp3.11:31.1: Sa jhānapasuto dhīro vanante ramito siyā, jhāyetha rukkhamūlasmiṃ attānam abhitosayaṃ. || ||
snp3.11:32.1: Tato ratyā vivasane gāmantam abhihāraye, avhānaṃ nābhinandeyya abhihārañ ca gāmato. || ||
snp3.11:33.1: Na munī gāmam āgamma kulesu sahasā care ghāsesanaṃ chinnakatho, na vācam payutaṃ bhaṇe. || ||
snp3.11:34.1: ‘Alatthaṃ yad, idaṃ sādhu, nālatthaṃ, kusalām' iti ubhayen' eva so tādī rukkhaṃ va upanivattati. || ||
snp3.11:35.1: Sa pattapāṇī vicaranto amūgo mūgasammato appaṃ dānaṃ na hīḷeyya, dātāraṃ nāvajāniya. || ||
snp3.11:36.1: Uccāvacā hi paṭipadā samaṇena pakāsitā: na pāraṃ diguṇaṃ yanti, na idaṃ ekaguṇaṃ mutaṃ. || ||
snp3.11:37.1: Yassa ca visatā n' atthi chinnasotassa bhikkhuno, kiccākiccappahīnassa pariḷāho na vijjati. || ||
snp3.11:38.1: Moneyyan te upaññissan: ti Bhagavā khuradhārūpamo bhave, jivhāya tāluṃ āhacca udare saññato siyā, || ||
snp3.11:39.1: alānacitto ca siyā, na cāpi bahu cintaye, nirāmagandho asito brahmacariyaparāyano. || ||
snp3.11:40.1: Ekāsanassa sikkhetha samaṇopāsanassa ca, ekattaṃ monam akkhātaṃ, eko ce abhiramissati, || || atha bhāsihi dasa disā.
snp3.11:41.1: Sutvā dhīrānaṃ nigghosaṃ jhāyīnaṃ kāmacāginaṃ tato hiriñ ca saddhañ ca bhiyyo kubbetha māmako. || ||
snp3.11:42.1: Tan nadīhi vijānātha sobbhesu padaresu ca: saṇantā yanti kussobbhā, tuṇhī yāti mahodadhi. || ||
snp3.11:43.1: Yad ūnakaṃ, taṃ saṇati, yaṃ pūraṃ, santam eva taṃ: aḍḍhakumbhūpamo bālo, rahado pūro va paṇḍito. || ||
snp3.11:44.1: Yaṃ samaṇo bahu bhāsati upetaṃ atthasaṃhitaṃ jānaṃ so dhammaṃ deseti, jānaṃ so bahu bhāsati. || ||
snp3.11:45.1: Yo ca jānaṃ yatatto, jānaṃ na bahu bhāsati, sa munī monam arahati, sa munī monam ajjhagā" ti || || NALAKASUTTAṂ NIṬṬHITAṂ.
